# Text (H5P.AdvancedText)

Formatted text, a part other content holds: in a page, a book, a slide, a scenario or an accordion. Not a content type on its own.

- `text` takes the tags the Fields section lists: headings, lists, links, emphasis. Plain text is wrapped in paragraphs, a blank line between two.

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "H5P.Column",
  "params": {
    "content": [
      { "content": { "library": "H5P.AdvancedText", "params": { "text": "<h2>Rivers</h2><p>A river has:</p><ul><li>a source</li><li>a course</li><li>a mouth</li></ul>" } } }
    ]
  }
}
```
